# Foreman by Turki Alshuaibi

> A build playbook that turns a coding agent into the foreman of a website build. It interviews the owner, forces the design and scope decisions, locks a visual system, writes one build brief, then builds the site or hands the brief to a coding agent, and verifies, ships and indexes it. Version 3.0.0, 27 October 2026.

Foreman is an Agent Skill, distributed as a Claude Code plugin and as a plain folder of markdown that works with any agent that reads files. It contains no executable code: no scripts, no hooks, no MCP servers, no network calls.

- 8 gated steps: orient, decide, lock the look, write the brief, build, verify, ship, index.
- 3 modes: Survey (the fewest questions; the agent researches the repo, site and CV and sends one decision sheet with a source on every line), Blueprint (the default, the full interview) and Stress test (every answer pushed once). Every decision is made in all three.
- 4 tools that run on their own: board (reference sites chosen for a brief), punch list (an audit of any site for what makes it look AI-generated or unfinished), palette (colours from a named material, contrast checked) and launch (domain, DNS, SSL, metadata, sitemap, indexing). In Claude Code: /foreman:board, /foreman:punch-list, /foreman:palette, /foreman:launch.
- 14 references loaded only when their step arrives, including design standards (colour theory, proportion and the golden ratio, type scale and measure, spacing, gestalt, motion timing, optical correction), and 7 fillable templates.

Its governing claim is that the quality of an agent's output is bounded by the quality of the brief it was given, so the work of a good build is decision-making rather than typing.

Author: Turki Alshuaibi, AI engineer and designer, Saudi Arabia. MIT licensed.

## Pages
- [Foreman by Turki Alshuaibi · Build playbook for coding agents](https://foreman.turkialshuaibi.com/): Foreman makes your coding agent interview you, lock a visual system, and write the brief before any code, then ship and index the site. Free, markdown only.
- [Reference board for your website · Foreman](https://foreman.turkialshuaibi.com/board/): Foreman's board finds real sites for your brief, as a list or a visual board with screenshots, and turns the ones you keep into principles you can build from.
- [Foreman changelog · every release since 1.0](https://foreman.turkialshuaibi.com/changelog/): Every Foreman release since 1.0.0 in August 2026: what changed in the playbook, and the failed build or the feedback that caused it.
- [Install Foreman in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and more](https://foreman.turkialshuaibi.com/install/): Install Foreman in Claude Code with two commands, or copy one folder of markdown into Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI or the Claude apps.
- [Launch a website: domain, DNS, SSL, indexing · Foreman](https://foreman.turkialshuaibi.com/launch/): Foreman's launch tool takes a site built anywhere to live and found: domain, DNS, SSL, the share card, a real 404, the sitemap and Search Console, one step at a time.
- [Survey, Blueprint, Stress test · Foreman's three modes](https://foreman.turkialshuaibi.com/modes/): Foreman runs at three depths. Survey researches instead of asking, Blueprint is the full interview, Stress test pushes every answer once. Every decision is made in all three.
- [Website colour palette from a real material · Foreman](https://foreman.turkialshuaibi.com/palette/): Foreman's palette tool turns a material you name into three website palettes that differ on ground, accent and contrast, every pair measured, shown on your real content.
- [Punch list: why your site looks AI-generated · Foreman](https://foreman.turkialshuaibi.com/punch-list/): Point Foreman's punch list at any URL, project or screenshot. It lists every dead button, missing state, metadata gap and generated-page tell, ranked, with a fix for each.

## Full text
- [llms-full.txt](https://foreman.turkialshuaibi.com/llms-full.txt): SKILL.md and the four toolbelt files in one file.

## Source
- Repository: https://github.com/Turki-Sh/Foreman
- The skill: https://github.com/Turki-Sh/Foreman/blob/main/plugins/foreman/skills/foreman/SKILL.md
- Cross-tool install paths: https://github.com/Turki-Sh/Foreman/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Install
- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add Turki-Sh/Foreman` then `/plugin install foreman@alshuaibi`
- Any other agent: copy `plugins/foreman/skills/foreman/` into the agent's skills directory
